description: This file defines an interface 'KafkaSpecificConfig' that encapsulates configuration logic for Kafka connections within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for checking applicability, validation, ensuring valid configuration values, and applying Kafka-specific settings to producer properties.

classes.name: KafkaSpecificConfig
classes.description: An interface for managing Kafka configuration logic such as applicability, validation, and applying configuration settings.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the Kafka configuration is applicable to the provided connection.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection against Kafka configuration, throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the connection configuration contains valid Kafka values.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies Kafka-specific configuration to the producer properties if applicable and valid.
